stories.title: Ballmer to accept NBA's punishments, has 'regrets'
stories.summary: LA Clippers owner Steve Ballmer says he is complying with the NBA's punishments of the franchise and will not pursue any legal action.

stories.title: Harbaugh: Giants' victory vs. Cowboys in debut ranks as No. 1 win right now
stories.summary: John Harbaugh came away pleased with his team's performance in his Big Apple debut.

stories.title: Johnson doubles down on Bears' offense after 59-point Week 1 eruption
stories.summary: The Bears walked away from their opener with a historic 59-37 win over the Panthers, one that saw them score the fourth-most points in a game in franchise history and saw the teams combine for 96 points, most ever in a season opener.

stories.title: Packers left without answers after blowing another lead late
stories.summary: The Packers' late-game woes from last season continued in Week 1 after they blew yet another big lead in Sunday's 39-22 loss to the Vikings.

stories.title: Saints irked by overturned TD, and its 'huge momentum swing'
stories.summary: In New Orleans' wild 31-30 overtime loss to the Detroit Lions on Sunday afternoon at Ford Field, there was a controversial overturned defensive touchdown that Saints coach Kellen Moore labeled "a little bit of a challenging circumstance."
